scope: Every regular file recursively in own lane at terminal seal, including all completed receiptJSON, helpers/frozeninputs, original literals, plans, denied outcomes, ledger/hashchain, frozen-after and all handoff files. No symlink following.
why: Manifest cannot hash itself. Terminal runner receipt/output are created only after manifest snapshot and contain the manifest-writing command; they are named explicitly rather than covered by a circular claim. No other completed receipts excluded.
no_later_work: After seal no substantive local work or network; final response links handoff. Frozen-after precedes seal and frozen files are never changed.
